title: Derived mate and the underived sections map
statement: Let f:X→S be any scheme morphism, s:Spec Ω→S a geometric point, K∈D⁺(Ab(X_et)), n∈ℤ, J a bounded-below complex of injective abelian etale sheaves on X and q:K≅Q(ιJ). Put M=ιJ and L=f_*M; identify Rf_*K with QL by sourceInjectiveDirectImageIso [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-injective-source-comparison]. For every pointed neighbourhood i, the composite of strictLocalComplexSectionRestriction [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-localized-hom-germ], global sections of H^n of the derived mate, and strictLocalBaseChangeTargetIso [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-mate-projection-data] equals H^n of the chain map obtained by applying strictLocalUnderivedMateSections f s i degreewise [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-underived-sections-mate], followed by the inverse localization/homology factorization and representativeSectionsComparison for p:X×_S S_(s)→X [lem-weil-pbc-injective-sections-pullback-comparison]. No neighbourhood cone geometry is chosen and no identification of the underived map with cone restriction is asserted.

proof.text: Factor the underived sections mate into the degreewise neighbourhood restriction and the underived global exchange. Expand strictLocalComplexSectionRestriction. Apply strictLocalDerivedExchange_globalSections to the latter factor, and use naturality of homologyFunctorFactors.inv to move localization past the composite chain map.

Use the general pointed-section-cone restriction on strictLocalSectionCone, the existing exact-sections instance for the small colimit model, and the general exact-global-sections Leray comparison wherever the former specialized restriction API was used. The cone restriction has the same section formulas, its germ predicate is definitionally identical, and uniqueness identifies the chosen stalk maps. All other argument steps and all scheme models stay as before.
